# Mages City Agent Knowledge Runtime

Status: design. Source inspection: 2026-09-08.

The City knowledge-space design connects a scoped working space, contributions, task receipts and a later earned address. Wiki rights, membership, DNS entitlement and key custody remain distinct grants enforced by their receiving services.

This node describes the integration contract; individual live services require separate evidence.
